messages:
Noah (Sales): Quick context — large fintech prospect wants a POC. Key asks: model hosting in Singapore + Frankfurt, per-tenant data residency, list of APAC subprocessors, and a routing policy that keeps traffic in APAC unless failover needed. Also need pricing for reserved capacity across two regions.
Priyanka (Sales Eng): Got it. Two quick clarifiers: 1) Do they require strict geofencing (no cross-region egress ever) or soft-preference with controlled failover? 2) Any required certifications for APAC subprocessors?
Noah (Sales): They said strict for EU regs, but in APAC they want “preferred” — can failover to EU on outages but must notify. Certs: ISO27001 is minimum; AICPA/SOC2 would be nice.
Priyanka (Sales Eng): OK. We can support that with a routing policy that prefers ap-southeast-1 and falls back to eu-central-1. Example config to share with them:
```yaml
routing_policy:
  prefer_region: ap-southeast-1
  fallback_regions:
    - eu-central-1
  strict_geofence: false  # true = block all cross-region egress
  notify_on_failover: true
  pin_tenant_region: true
```
Priyanka (Sales Eng): Notes: set pin_tenant_region=true to keep their tenant pinned to SG unless a health-based failover triggers. notify_on_failover will generate alert events they can subscribe to.
Sam (SRE): A couple infra notes: 1) Cross-region failover will cause KV cache misses and cold starts — expect ~200–500ms extra p99 in worst-case until cache warms depending on model and sequence lengths. 2) If they want zero egress, we need private deployment (VPC/on-prem) or Dedicated with an explicit no-egress SLA.
Noah (Sales): Good to know — they asked about encryption for egress and KMS. Can we support customer-managed keys in APAC?
Sam (SRE): Yes — KMS integration available in Private and Dedicated. For Hosted, we offer server-side keys; CMK/HSM for Private. Also confirm network path: we can peer into customer VPCs in some regions, or use TLS with mutual auth.
Marta (Legal): For subprocessors: I can share our subprocessors inventory but need to confirm APAC vendor list for SG region — some cloud infra partners are region-specific. Also they asked about DPA changes for cross-region failover — we'll need to add an exception clause with customer consent.
deploy-bot: POC environment created: redwood-poc-1800456789 in ap-southeast-1 (models provisioned: gptx-7b-quant).
Noah (Sales): Pricing question — they want a ballpark for Dedicated reserved pool in SG + FR for 3 months POC. Also incremental egress cost if failover occurs.
Priyanka (Sales Eng): Ballpark: Dedicated regional pool (1x A100-equivalent capacity) ~ $45k/month in SG, $40k/month in FR (list price varies). Short POC discounts possible — I can pull exact quote. Cross-region egress estimate depends on traffic — recommend adding a metered egress line item. Also recommend using prefix caching and local replica to cut token cost during normal ops.
Sam (SRE): Operationally: recommend canary failover window and warm standby in FR to reduce impact. That lowers latency spike but raises reserved cost.
Marta (Legal): I need security questionnaire items: subprocessors list, encryption at rest/in transit, KMS options, data retention, incident response contacts. Noah — can you push their questionnaire?
Noah (Sales): Sending now. Also they want a short tech doc explaining routing policy + how failover is audited. Priyanka — can you draft and attach the YAML + sequence of events for failover?
Priyanka (Sales Eng): On it. I'll draft the tech note and subproc inventory for SG, include the YAML snippet and a simple diagram. ETA EOD.
Marta (Legal): I'll pre-check DPA edits and confirm what we can commit for notify_on_failover clause.
Sam (SRE): I'll prepare a short ops note on cache warmup mitigation and recommended canary config.
Noah (Sales): Awesome — next steps: Priyanka publishes tech note + pricing estimate, Marta confirms DPA edits, Sam prepares ops note. I'll update the customer and schedule POC kickoff. :thumbsup:
Priyanka (Sales Eng): Added task: create a small demo routing policy in the demo account so we can show failover events in the POC.
Noah (Sales): Thanks everyone — looping in the customer for a 30-min kickoff once docs are ready.
